rig.construction: Original MakeHuman authored skeletal influences, normalized per source vertex. Cervical family descends from neck01; moving arm family descends from upperarm01.L/R. Clavicle and shoulder-girdle influences remain on the thorax because this reduced rig articulates the humerus, not the source clavicle bones. Body and garment use the same original source vertex/barycentric bindings.

metadata.construction: Original adult female thigh, kneecap, shin and calf radial anatomy. Native quads clipped at the same20%femur plane as the connected body and12mm before source ankle, axial lengths fitted to42cm/42cm. Original two clean source boundaries; thigh root welded to source body and short ankle bridge to retained anatomical feet. Shared-knee quaternion bend; no lathe, knee sphere or independent calf primitive.
